Pavle Slepcev


I'm a Mechanical and Space Engineering student at the University of Pittsburgh (Class of 2028). 

Currently: Drivetrain sub-team on Pitt's Formula SAE electric team and Co-Founder of WASP I Computer Vision, Drone.


Featured projects


Drone Navigation

WASP — absolute position without GPS or any radio link, by matching camera frames to satellite imagery. Flight-tested.



6 DOF Robot - Arm


An open-source 6-axis robotic arm — sourced, 3D-printed, and driven by stepper motors. 

Bridge-Design 

A gradient-descent truss optimizer written in MATLAB, verified in SOLIDWORKS. The bridge held 994 lb at 244 g.


Custom Keyboard PCB

A mechanical keyboard PCB designed end to end in KiCad, schematic through board layout.
